lines: That sentence split like cheap stitching.
I have seen split stitching with more sense than that.
Careful. Even hide looks softer than your manners right now.
You walk in like trouble forgot to close the door behind it.
I have seen broken leather with better instincts than you.
Careful. The village has long memories and very little patience today.
You are not as frightening as you think. That may be the problem.
If foolishness made noise, you would drown out the bell.
Do not test me just because I am speaking in complete sentences.
Your confidence is <shake>louder</shake> than your sense.
You are coming apart at every seam.
I have seen rotten straps with better grip on reality.
That thought needs patching before it goes outside.
Your manners are stiff, cracked, and badly cured.
I would not trust that attitude to hold a buckle.
You have the charm of wet leather left in a corner.
Even a torn boot knows when it has gone too far.
Your sense wears thin faster than cheap soles.
That remark was a bad cut from poor material.
I could stitch a pouch before finding a point in that.

A frayed strap has more discipline than you.
Your confidence needs oiling and possibly replacing.
